newsitem.title: USA: Evans refocusing buying, marketing effort.
newsitem.headline: Evans refocusing buying, marketing effort.

text.p: Evans Inc said it is refocusing its buying and marketing strategies to reverse a trend that resulted in deeper losses for the November 30 third quarter.
The retailer did not provide further details.

Chief financial officer William Koziel attributed the decline in the quarter to tighter availability of consumer credit due to the record high levels of consumer debt as well as significant increases this year in fur prices, primarily mink.

"Also, our apparel sales have continued at a declining trend year-to-date which the company believes is the result of increasing competitive pressure from department and discount stores," Koziel said in a statement.
